content: The RTE shall ensure that the RunnableEntity implementing a server operation has completed the processing of a request before it begins process- ing the next request, if serialization is required by the server operation, i.e canBeIn- vokedConcurrently attribute of the server is set to FALSE and client RunnableEn- tity s to OsTask mapping ( RteEventToTaskMapping ) may lead to concurrent in- vocations of the server.
